name: eat-a-kid-bench
description: A safety-oriented benchmark that probes whether models comply with or refuse highly harmful, explicit instructions (e.g., violent or illicit prompts). It measures models' robustness to malicious prompts and their adherence to safety policies by evaluating refusal behavior and safe response generation. Examples test both direct solicitations to commit harm and attempts to evade safety filters.
reputation: A small, provocative niche dataset used by researchers to stress-test safety and refusal behavior; limited mainstream adoption.
